map.计算 Sigmoid 函数值与分类阈值。: Compute the Sigmoid function value and the classification threshold.
map.σ(z) = 1/(1 + e^(−z))；对数几率 logit = ln[p/: sigma(z) = 1/(1 + e^(-z)); log-odds logit = ln[p/(1 - p)] = z
map.Sigmoid 把任意实数压到 (0,1)，输出可直接当概率用；其导数 σ′=σ: Sigmoid squeezes any real number into (0,1), usable directly as a probability; its derivative sigma' = sigma(1-sigma) tends to 0 when |z| is large, one root cause of vanishing gradients in deep networks, so hidden layers now mostly switch to the ReLU family. The threshold need not be fixed at 0.5; adjust it by business cost.
map.σ(x)=1/(1+e⁻ˣ)，将任意实数映射到 (0,1)，用于二分类概率化。: sigma(x)=1/(1+e^-x), mapping any real number to (0,1), used to probabilize binary classification.
map.x=0 时 σ=0.5；x 很大趋近 1、很小趋近 0，具饱和性。: At x=0 sigma=0.5; for very large x it approaches 1, very small approaches 0, being saturating.
map.与 BCE 损失配合；其导数 σ'(x)=σ(x)(1−σ(x))，便于反向传播: Paired with BCE loss; its derivative sigma'(x)=sigma(x)(1-sigma(x)) eases backprop.
map.logit=2 → σ=1/(1+e⁻²)=0.881；logit=−2 → σ: logit=2 -> sigma=1/(1+e^-2)=0.881; logit=-2 -> sigma=0.119; logit=0 -> 0.5. Each +1 in logit pushes probability toward 1 but decelerates (saturation).
map.Sigmoid 和 Softmax 区别？: What is the difference between Sigmoid and Softmax?
map.Sigmoid 独立处理每个 logit、输出各维独立概率(可不和为1)，适合多: Sigmoid handles each logit independently, outputting independent per-dimension probabilities (need not sum to 1), suiting multi-label; Softmax normalizes so class probabilities sum to 1, suiting single-label multi-class.
map.为什么 Sigmoid 易饱和导致梯度消失？: Why does Sigmoid easily saturate and cause vanishing gradients?
map.当 |x| 很大时 σ 接近 0 或 1，导数≈0，反向传播梯度趋零；深层网络常: When |x| is large, sigma approaches 0 or 1 and the derivative ~ 0, so backprop gradients vanish; deep networks often use BatchNorm and ReLU to ease this, or switch to Swish.
map.Sigmoid 分类口径（与上方 σ(z) 公式互补）：σ(z)=1÷(1+e^: Sigmoid classification (complementary to the σ(z) formula above): σ(z)=1÷(1+e^(−z)) is the output probability; classification compares σ(z) with the threshold — σ(z)≥threshold means "positive", otherwise "negative"; log-odds=ln[σ÷(1−σ)], identical to the input z (a logit inverse-transform check). Validation: no strict checks; empty values count as 0. Grading: with a threshold of 0.5 a probability over half is positive; raising the threshold is more conservative (more misses, fewer false alarms).
